method: Independent in-session fundamental analyst, exact stored fundamentals system prompt applied; dated issuer evidence replaces undated financial-statement trend claims.

sources.title: IOIPG latest observed issuer financial/fund disclosure
observed_facts: FY revenue RM4.444bn versus RM3.062bn; owners profit RM2.154bn versus RM1.064bn. Q4 owners profit fell to RM523.111m from RM823.930m.
FY PBT includes RM855.177m property fair-value gains and RM502.789m joint-venture remeasurement; reported EPS is not recurring earning power.
Borrowings RM25.353bn versus RM19.590bn; cash/deposits RM3.535bn. CFO RM2.391bn is positive, but acquisition outlays require separate cash-flow treatment.
limitations: Direct issuer FY26 report retrieved via current investor-centre; older investor page query routes returned stale FY22/FY23 files and were excluded. No intrinsic valuation or matched peers established.
Vendor statement timing metadata absent; no snapshot YoY financial trend inferred.
Forward P/E is a vendor estimate, not realised earnings or intrinsic value.
